boundary.actor_source: unchanged study001 selected actor checkpoints; no new actor-training cost attributed to zero
boundary.calibration: one positive temperature fit on training prefixes; all three primary policies share calibrated odds
boundary.cold_replay: first Python episode per split/policy is replayed from serialized state in-process; first continuing native episode per split/policy restores stream, task cursor and native owner in a new native process
boundary.comparison: same actor, calibrated odds, SNR/cost/horizon, correctness reward and every paid observation; causal stop

native.action_authority: original sparse kernel and native NDU

boundary.utility_intervals: four value-minus-fixed/direct contrasts across ID/OOD; 98.75% paired Student-t intervals

limits: Fresh episode seed does not create a new raw MNIST/FSDD source population.
Equal process CPU does not imply equal updates, parameter count, energy or optimized GPU cost.
CPU-budget update counts depend on machine/runtime; input streams and retained checkpoints remain reproducible.
The natural cell threshold remains learned; task Bellman stopping is a separate value boundary.
Neural score calibration does not prove Bayesian Markov transition correctness.
Long-memory grows genuine distractors; joint multimodal length remains null-step stress.
Original native value-to-action adapter is not evidence of learned sparse-head superiority.

primary.budget: 12 process-CPU training seconds for each LR; all search overhead charged separately; final step overshoot retained
primary.mechanism: HCSN minus each of four paired controls; accuracy; five seeds; per-task 98.75% Student-t CI
primary.representation_scaling: descriptive mean and sample SD across three optimization seeds
primary.selection: validation CE only across both learning rates and three CPU milestones; fixed candidate-order ties

stream_measurement.scope: full-sequence versus genuine incremental forward; reset and restoration costs separate; persistent state bytes not RSS
stream_measurement.selection: all representation seed6201 and scaling seed7301 winners, independent of score
stream_measurement.separate_process_replay: seven MNIST representation winners at seed6201
